name: Iwasaka Kaoru
source:
A beach volleyball professional, called "the princess" by her fans.. Kaoru has many fans of both sexes, she always receives confessions of love from the boys but she always rejects them.

Due to being a tomboyish girl, she is known in the field as "the prince of volleyball", due to this nickname she has declared on TV that she would like to be seen as a princess and struggles to improve her feminine image to the public.

She has been active in the national volleyball team since she was in middle school.

"This thing of pretending to be cool when you're not cool... I don't like it."
